# RESEARCH PROJECT DOCUMENT

## Research on data science
**Data science** is one the most important subject in human lives. All beings, things ***contain*** data, ***produce*** data and ***deal*** with data around us.
Data science is about dealing withat data and retrieving useful ***insights*** from it which can benefit everyone.

## Research on Machine learning
Machine learning involves mostly with **Ai and analytics** and how one can model the problems and extract solutions from it.
One of the main codes used in modeling *linear regression* is $y=mx+c$.
